title: Networking from the CLI
task: Run the API with APP_MODE=ready, save the /health response to health.txt, and leave the API running while you check.
hints: Inspect app.py to find the variable controlling readiness.
Start the server in the background and read server.port.

checks.label: health.txt contains the healthy response
checks.feedback: Use curl on the running API and save its response.

checks.label: The running local API responds with HTTP 200 and the expected body
checks.feedback: Leave the API running in this lab and inspect server.log.

demo.explanation: The mode is inherited at startup. Use $! to capture the PID.
Use the assigned port from server.port in your workspace.
